notes: 'hath' is given to the participle s004 as the nomen rectum of יִתְרוֹן הָעֹשֶׂה, the construct relation being what the ASV recast possessively (rules 19 and 43). Rule 43's subtraction confirms it: dropping 'hath' leaves the relation between 'profit' and 'he that worketh' unstated and nothing else. The competing reading marks it added under rule 43's closing count, since no הָיָה, possessive preposition or suffix stands in the clause; it is recorded in the unit note.
s003 takes 'he that' and heads on the pronoun under rule 41's first sentence, which is the article's own rendering; rule 46's heading on the lexeme reaches only an anarthrous substantive.
